adjudication.rationale: In `lib/tasks/disqus.thor`, topic creation was changed from `PostCreator.new(... created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at]) ...)` to `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`, and `TopicEmbed.import_remote`/`.import` do not pass or set `created_at`, so the imported thread timestamp is no longer honored. Also, `TopicEmbed.import` explicitly returns `nil` unless `url =~ /^https?\:\/\//`, and the Thor task only processes comments inside `if post.present?`, so non-http(s) thread links will result in the thread (and its comments) being skipped without further handling in this code path.
